subject: Evidence handback cadence & SIG/CAIQ rotations — FedRAMP window implications
messages:
From: Katie Lam <katie.lam@orchidfinancial.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: security@orchidfinancial.com
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence rotation + SIG/CAIQ cadence for upcoming FedRAMP intake

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. As we start scoping our FedRAMP intake, the audit team asked for clarity on two operational items we need from Redwood to finalize our intake plan:

1) Evidence handback cadence: for SOC 2 and SIG-derived artifacts, do you provide periodic snapshots (monthly/quarterly) or is evidence delivered on request during a sampling window? The auditor prefers a predictable handback schedule.

2) SIG/CAIQ rotation: when you update control narratives or re-run control evidence (e.g., KMS config snapshots, log retention samples), do you keep a rotation history or overwrite current artifacts? We need to specify retention and sampling policy in our FedRAMP submission.

Can you also confirm who at Redwood will be the primary control owner for
- encryption key management (KMS) evidence,
- logging and retention snapshots, and
- network boundary diagrams for the FedRAMP submission.

If you have a short runbook or a matrix that maps artifact -> cadence -> owner, that would be perfect. We’re aiming to lock the audit window by next Thursday (2026-08-19).

Best,
Katie
Katie Lam
Senior Security Program Manager | Orchid Financial
[attachment: intake-ask-template.docx (document)]

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Katie Lam <katie.lam@orchidfinancial.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence rotation + SIG/CAIQ cadence for upcoming FedRAMP intake

Thanks Katie — great questions. Quick answers up front, then proposed next steps so we can meet your timeline: 

Summary answers:
- Evidence handback: Redwood offers both: a scheduled snapshot export (monthly or quarterly) and on-demand extraction for audit windows. For FedRAMP intake we recommend a monthly export for log and KMS artifacts plus a targeted extraction for the auditor's sampling window.
- Rotation/retention: We retain rotation history for config and snapshot artifacts for 13 months by default (can extend to 24 months on Dedicated/Private). We do not permanently overwrite snapshots — we version them and tag with snapshot timestamps.
- Primary control owners (for your submission):
  * KMS evidence: David Kim (Infrastructure Security)
  * Logs & retention snapshots: Grace O'Connor (Observability & Ops)
  * Network boundary diagrams: Ava Chen (Product Security)

What I’m attaching: a first-pass evidence matrix that maps artifact -> cadence -> retention -> owner (see evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx). Also attaching a high-level FedRAMP scope diagram placeholder.

Questions for you: 
1) Do auditors require a snapshot backfill prior to the intake window (e.g., 3 months of consecutive monthly snapshots) or will a single extraction plus retention proofs suffice?
2) Are there specific dates you expect to put in the intake (we can align export windows)?
3) Any non-standard artifacts they expect (screenshot/console exports) that we should prepare playbooks for?

Proposed next steps (to meet 8/19 lock):
- Today/Mon: Redwood owners confirm feasibility and timeline (Grace/David) — short call if helpful.
- Tue: We run a one-time backfill export if needed.
- Wed: We provide the archive links and a short runbook for the auditor.

If that works I’ll open a Jira and assign owners.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Product Security Lead | Redwood Inference
[attachment: evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Katie Lam <katie.lam@orchidfinancial.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: security@orchidfinancial.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence rotation + SIG/CAIQ cadence for upcoming FedRAMP intake

Ava — this is exactly what we need, thank you. Quick clarifications from the audit side: 

- Backfill: auditor prefers 3 consecutive monthly snapshots for configuration and KMS evidence leading up to the intake window; for logs they will accept a single targeted export with retention proofs.
- Intake lock: target window is the week of 2026-09-06 — so ideally we’d have the backfill complete by 2026-08-31.
- Non-standard artifacts: occasional console screenshots and a signed attestation for 3rd-party subprocessor list (they will ask during the intake).

We can live with the 13-month default retention as long as versioned snapshots are included in the evidence bundle.

If you can confirm owners and whether Redwood can do the 3-month backfill by 8/31, we’ll mark the intake window in our calendar and share the auditor contact (we prefer Redwood to push the archive links to a secure S3 share or a signed Drive link).

Thanks — Katie

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Katie Lam <katie.lam@orchidfinancial.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence rotation + SIG/CAIQ cadence for upcoming FedRAMP intake

Katie / team —

Confirmed: we can produce the 3-month backfill for config and KMS artifacts and a targeted log export by 2026-08-31. Action items below and owners assigned: 

- David Kim: run KMS config snapshot exports (Jul/Aug/Sept) and upload to secure S3 share by 2026-08-27. [owner, evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx row 4]
- Grace O'Connor: run log retention proof export and prepare a short runbook for the auditor; prepare screenshot playbook for intermittent console artifacts by 2026-08-28. [owner, evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx row 7]
- Ava Chen: produce network boundary diagram and signed attestation for subprocessor list; coordinate secure link exchange with Orchid audit team by 2026-08-30.

I’ll open SEC-1423 and attach the matrix and timeline. Grace/David — if you want to sync quickly tomorrow morning I’m free 9:00–10:30 PT.

Thanks,
Ava
